description: This file defines a React component named CategoryShop that displays products filtered by category, manages loading states, and handles updates when the category slug changes. It connects to Redux store to fetch products and authentication status, and renders a product list or a not found message accordingly.

classes.name: CategoryShop
classes.description: A React component that displays products filtered by category, with loading and empty state handling.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches products for the current category slug when the component mounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Refetches products if the category slug in the URL changes.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the product list, loading indicator, or not found message based on current state and props.
